zh.title: 颱風白海豚逼近 台北往返金門8日晚間多航班取消
zh.summary: 受颱風白海豚影響，2026年8月8日晚間台北往返金門有多個航班取消或調整時間。立榮航空取消2個往返航班並有1班提早起飛；華信航空亦取消與調整部分航班。金門氣象站指出，颱風預計於8月9日與10日對金門產生較大影響。
body: 受颱風白海豚影響，2026年8月8日晚間台北往返金門的多個航班宣告取消或調整起飛時間。航空公司已依據氣象動態更新官網航班資訊，提醒往返兩地的旅客注意交通異動。
依據立榮航空官網訊息，8日晚間共有2個台北往返金門航班取消，另有1個航班提前起飛。華信航空官網異動資訊則顯示，台北往返金門有1個航班取消、1架次金門往台北取消，以及1架次台北往金門航班提前起飛。
金門氣象站主任林依締表示，颱風白海豚預計於8月9日與10日對金門影響最大，預估最大陣風達7至8級、平均風力約5級。隨颱風逐漸進入內陸，相關警報解除後航班影響將隨之減小。

en.title: Typhoon Dolphin Prompts Taipei-Kinmen Flight Cancellations
en.summary: Multiple flights between Taipei and Kinmen were cancelled or rescheduled on the evening of August 8, 2026, due to the influence of Typhoon Dolphin. UNI Air cancelled two round-trip flights between Taipei and Kinmen while adjusting another to depart early. Mandarin Airlines also announced flight disruptions, including cancelled flights and an early departure. The Kinmen Weather Station reported that the typhoon is expected to bring its greatest weather impact to Kinmen on August 9 and 10.
body: Multiple flights between Taipei and Kinmen were cancelled or rescheduled on the evening of August 8, 2026, due to the influence of Typhoon Dolphin. Airlines updated their flight schedules as weather conditions developed, advising passengers to monitor transportation notices.

According to UNI Air's official schedule, two Taipei-Kinmen flights were cancelled and one flight departed early on the evening of August 8. Mandarin Airlines reported changes including one cancelled Taipei-Kinmen flight, one cancelled Kinmen-Taipei flight, and one early Taipei-Kinmen departure.

Kinmen Weather Station Director Lin I-ti stated that Typhoon Dolphin is expected to have its greatest impact on Kinmen on August 9 and 10, with maximum gusts estimated at Beaufort scale 7 to 8. Flight disruptions are expected to diminish as the typhoon moves inland and warnings are lifted.
